body_html:
CT librarians serve on the front lines of the efforts to teach students to own their data. If you are already a WordPress blogger but want to learn more about taking control of the content you own by deciding where to share I encourage you to check out #indieweb.

I am currently recruiting participants to do a "think aloud" as you install #indieweb WordPress plug-ins and get your website compatible.

I just ask that you verbalize all of your decisions. After you are done I will help to make sure your settings are optimized.

Just reply if you are interested.

All research and data will be released using a CC 0 Public Domain license and we our governed by the #indieweb Code of Conduct: https://indieweb.org/code-of-conduct
